python << 'EOF'
import parse

print("=== R1: Trailing newline handling ===")
# Should match strings ending with newline
test_cases = [
    ('hello\n', 'hello\n'),
    ('{word}\n', 'test\n'),
    ('{0:d}\n', '42\n'),
    ('prefix {0}\n', 'prefix hello\n'),  # Fixed: matching prefix
    ('line1\nline2', 'line1\nline2'),
]

all_pass = True
for fmt, inp in test_cases:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, inp)
    if r is None:
        print(f"FAIL: parse({fmt!r}, {inp!r}) returned None")
        all_pass = False
    else:
        print(f"PASS: parse({fmt!r}, {inp!r}) = {r}")

if all_pass:
    print("\nR1: All trailing newline tests passed!")

print("\n=== R2: Digit field numbering with type conversions ===")
digit_tests = [
    ('{0:d}', '123', 123),
    ('{0:f}', '3.14', 3.14),
    ('{0:x}', 'ff', 255),
    ('{0:o}', '77', 63),
    ('{0:b}', '1010', 10),
    ('{0} and {1:d}', 'hello and 42', ('hello', 42)),
    ('{0:d} and {1:f}', '-10 and 3.14', (-10, 3.14)),  # Fixed: using "and" instead of "-"
]

all_pass = True
for fmt, inp, expected in digit_tests:
    try:
        r = parse.parse(fmt, inp)
        if r is None:
            print(f"FAIL: parse({fmt!r}, {inp!r}) returned None")
            all_pass = False
        elif not isinstance(expected, tuple):
            # Single value case
            if r.fixed != (expected,):
                print(f"FAIL: parse({fmt!r}, {inp!r}) = {r.fixed}, expected ({expected},)")
                all_pass = False
            else:
                print(f"PASS: parse({fmt!r}, {inp!r}) -> fixed={r.fixed}")
        else:
            if r.fixed != expected:
                print(f"FAIL: parse({fmt!r}, {inp!r}) = {r.fixed}, expected {expected}")
                all_pass = False
            else:
                print(f"PASS: parse({fmt!r}, {inp!r}) -> fixed={r.fixed}")
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"ERROR: parse({fmt!r}, {inp!r}) raised {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        all_pass = False

if all_pass:
    print("\nR2: All digit field numbering tests passed!")
EOF
